materials.heading: Kayan aiki na asali
materials.lead: Kayan aiki {count} da ke cikin laburaren asali na Glazecalc, daga feldspar da yumɓu zuwa frit da tushen boron, kowanne da binciken oxide ɗinsa da haɗarinsa.
materials.intro: Kowane tsarin glaze a Glazecalc zai iya amfani da waɗannan kayan aiki. Kowane shafi yana ba da binciken oxide da gudummawar UMF da Glazecalc ke aiki da su, haɗarin kamar yadda laburaren ya rubuta su, da kuma inda ƙimomin suka fito.
materials.careAbout: Kafin ku taɓa kowane kayan glaze, ku karanta <mixing>Haɗawa cikin aminci da iska mai kyau</mixing> da <home>Kada ka sa wa iyalinka guba</home>.
materials.own: Kayan aikinku na kanku, waɗanda aka ajiye a asusunku, suna kan <own>shafin Kayana</own>. <cones>Jadawalin cone</cones> yana lissafa zafin cone.

material.lead: Kayan aiki na asali a laburaren Glazecalc: binciken oxide ɗinsa, gudummawar UMF da haɗarinsa.
material.analysisPercent: Glazecalc yana da binciken {name} a matsayin kashi bisa nauyi na ɗanyen kayan. Gudummawar UMF ita ce mole na kowane oxide a cikin adadin {name} da ke ɗauke da mole 1.0 na flux, kuma haka Glazecalc ke ƙara shi cikin UMF (unity molecular formula) na tsarin glaze.
material.analysisMolecular: Glazecalc yana da binciken {name} a matsayin mole na kowane oxide bayan gasa a kowane tsarin sinadarai. Gudummawar UMF ita ce mole na kowane oxide a cikin adadin {name} da ke ɗauke da mole 1.0 na flux, kuma haka Glazecalc ke ƙara shi cikin UMF (unity molecular formula) na tsarin glaze.
material.noFlux: {name} ba shi da oxide na flux, don haka gudummawar UMF ɗinsa bisa tsarin sinadarai ne kamar yadda aka rubuta shi.
material.weightsNote: Nauyin daidai shi ne giram na {name} da ke ɗauke da mole 1.0 na flux. Nauyi bayan gasa shi ne abin da ya rage daga wannan bayan gasa.
material.noAnalysis: Glazecalc bai iya fitar da bincike ga wannan kaya ba.
material.noHazards: Laburaren ba shi da bayanin haɗari ga wannan kaya. Ku duba takardar bayanan aminci daga mai sayar muku.
material.hasLead: Wannan kaya yana ƙunshe da oxide na darma (lead, Pb), wato PbO.
material.care: Glazecalc yana nuna kalmomin haɗari kamar yadda bayanin laburaren ya ba da su. Wannan ba cikakken kimanta haɗari ba ne, don haka ku karanta takardar bayanan aminci daga mai sayar muku. Kafin ku taɓa kowane kayan glaze, ku karanta <mixing>Haɗawa cikin aminci da iska mai kyau</mixing> da <home>Kada ka sa wa iyalinka guba</home>.
material.useHeading: Yi amfani da shi a tsarin glaze
material.use: Ƙara {name} cikin tsarin glaze a kalkuletan Glazecalc don ganin abin da yake yi wa UMF na glaze.

cones.heading: Jadawalin cone: cone na Orton da na SK
cones.lead: Zafin da Glazecalc ke amfani da shi ga pyrometric cone (mazugi) na Orton da na SK, a °C da °F, tare da saurin hawan zafi da suke nufi da kuma inda kowace ƙima ta fito.
cones.intro: Cone suna auna aikin zafi (heatwork), wato zafi da lokaci tare, ba zafi kaɗai ba. Zafin cone ya dogara ga yadda kiln ke hawan zafi da sauri a ƙarshe, don haka kowane jadawali a ƙasa yana faɗin saurinsa. Ku sa cone mai shaida (witness cone) a cikin kiln ku karanta shi, ko me jadawalin ya ce. <firing>Yadda ake zaɓa, ajiyewa da karanta cone</firing> yana cikin jagorar gasa.
cones.ortonCaption: Cone na Orton, 022 zuwa 15: manyan cone da aka dumama a {rate} °C a kowace awa ({rateF} °F a kowace awa)
cones.ortonSource: Tushe: {title}, kamar yadda {reprinted} ya sake buga shi.
cones.above: Orton yana kuma yin cone daga 16 zuwa 42. Orton ba ya wallafa zafi gare su, kuma babu jadawalin da muka samu da ya ba da ɗaya, don haka ba a nuna ko ɗaya ba: {list}.
cones.publishedHeading: Ƙimomin Orton na yanzu na kansa
cones.publishedIntro: Jadawalin Orton na {year} na cone 022 zuwa 14 yana ba da zafi ga kowane saurin hawan zafi, a cikin 100 °C na ƙarshe na gasar. Ƙimomin sun ɗan bambanta da na jadawalin da ke sama, wanda Glazecalc ke amfani da shi wajen duba cone.
cones.publishedCaption: Cone na Orton, 022 zuwa 14: zafi a °{unit}, bisa nau’in cone da saurin hawan zafi
cones.largeDiffers: Ana yin manyan cone 13 da 14 ta wata hanya daban, kuma suna da nasu zafin daidai.
cones.skCaption: Cone na SK, 022 zuwa 20: zafin lanƙwasa na suna (JIS R 8101)
cones.skIntro: Ana sayar da cone na SK (Seger) a Japan ƙarƙashin ma’aunin {standard}. Ƙimomin zafin ma’auni ne na wannan ma’aunin kamar yadda wani mai sayarwa ya buga su, ba abin da kiln zai nuna ba.
cones.skSource: Tushe: {seller}, jadawalin zafin lanƙwasa na ma’auni.
